title: 侧一点更舒服
description: 成人低位墙面做小幅侧身，让肩与髋稍转向一侧。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult makes a small side-on adjustment on a low wall, one hip approaching the wall and the nearer shoulder following naturally. Both feet remain on broad footholds and both hands secured on generous holds. Keep knees aligned comfortably, avoiding a deep drop-knee or dramatic twist. A three-quarter rear view shows the subtle body rotation while the head looks calmly at the next nearby handhold and the padded floor stays visible. Use layered cut-paper illustration with crisp overlapping shapes, shallow paper shadows, and cobalt, apricot, and ivory construction. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
